outline: Introduction to state-of-the-art lean manufacturing systems and practical skills. Tentative topics include: 1. lean principles; 2. value stream mapping synergy; 3. continuous improvement by single minute exchange of die; 4. internet of things applications; 5. theory of constraints etc.
